regions.today: Blustery today with sunny spells and scattered heavy showers, turning prolonged in places. Parts of the southeast will stay fully dry though. The showers will become well-scattered by evening and brisk northwesterly winds will ease with late sunshine occurring widely. A fresh day with highest temperatures of 15 to 17 degrees.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight as showers become isolated and clear spells develop. However, some drizzle or light showers will affect western fringes later. Cool with lowest temperatures of 6 to 10 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Wednesday will be a largely dry day with just light west to southwest breezes. Sunny spells further east but it will become cloudier through the day with the odd light shower later. Becoming cloudier everywhere later. Highest temperatures of 16 to 18 or 19 degrees, best values further east.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate today and Wednesday
